Post-episode Reflexion (not sent to GM):
New plan: I failed because I repeatedly used the command "put" to place the unpish on the table, which the game engine rejected. The instructions explicitly defined a special action called "tratel" (likely a typo for "travel" in the prompt's context, but defined as "to physically place something somewhere") for this purpose. Instead of guessing standard verbs like "put", "place", or "drop", I must strictly use the defined syntax: "> tratel [object] to [location]". My new strategy is to execute "> tratel unpish to table", then "> tratel plate to secti", and finally "> tratel mop to secti" (after retrieving the mop from the broom closet), before typing "> done".
